observations.detail: Recording 0:13 and the Stop control are visible initially. By 51.801667s the instruction has changed to Finishing your words…; its restrained reveal does not retain the previous instruction. The Stop control shows native pressed/disabled feedback. Keys and control positions remain stable before the test activates Sayso.

Native app activation transitions through a cached host snapshot and hides the keyboard before live ready content appears at 55.380000s. The returned keyboard shows the result preview and Insert with clear separation and no overlapping text. This does not establish a continuous visible keyboard processing-to-ready transition.

The Insert control receives native press feedback; by 60.683333s its checkmark and the new Inserted instruction are visible, followed by the disabled Inserted title. The new preview/instruction opacity settles without old/new paragraph overlap. The longer button title reduces available preview width and re-truncates it, while all key rows stay in place.

keyboardStartupDiagnosis.inference: The host abandoned the cold keyboard presentation before the ready controller arrived. The exact OS reason is unproven. Root reported concurrent high-resolution ffmpeg encoding during startup, a plausible contributing load, not established causation.
keyboardStartupDiagnosis.next_check: After the active suite completes, rerun only the keyboard test without concurrent encoding. If needed, explicitly select Sayso through the native input-mode picker to prewarm. Preserve the original failed bundle. No production fix is indicated by this evidence.
